notes.title: Horror Game about a sewage truck operator, Fecal Freighter Announced!
notes.notes: Fecal Freighter is a survival horror game about a sewage truck operator in an open world. It’s a brutal test of survival in an unbearable stench. Take the wheel of a ZIL-130 truck and tackle the dirty work of waste disposal—while fending off aliens determined to steal your precious cargo. The game is set to release in late 2025.
